purpose: Bounded finite measured tests requested by M6 Pass C (+Strionic Resonator -Swiftfoot Boots; +Seize the Day -Black Market Connections; Loki present/absent, valid/invalid Villain target, haste/protection, combat-two payability, response windows, delayed token sacrifice) plus deployment cost of the selected swaps. Seeded goldfish deployment model and an exhaustive rules-encoded scenario grid; not a game simulation, not a source-bound game-engine receipt and not a win rate.

scripts.meas:
"""Bounded finite Pass C tests for Loki__the_Deceiver (Deck 28). Part A: seeded finite Monte Carlo goldfish of
deployment (seed 28, fixed N, on the play, no mulligans, no opponent). Part B: exhaustive finite rules-encoded
scenario grid (deterministic, enumerated). Neither part is a win-rate simulation."""
import json,re,random,itertools,collections
W='/workspace/d28w/'
SC=json.load(open(W+'scry_live.json')); ALL={x['name']:x for x in SC['cards']}; ALL.update({x['name']:x for x in SC['baseline_cards']})
def load(p):
    out=[]
    for l in open(p):
        m=re.match(r'(\d+)x (.+?)( \[Commander\])?$',l.strip())
        if m and not m.group(3): out+=[m.group(2)]*int(m.group(1))
    return out
base=load(W+'base.txt'); assert len(base)==99
def swap(d,pairs):
    d=d[:]
    for a,c in pairs: d.remove(c); d.append(a)
    return d
ULT=("Ultimo, Civilization's End","Crimson Cowl, Master of Evil"); ELE=("Elektra, Daughter of the Hand","Killmonger, Ruthless Usurper")
STR=("Strionic Resonator","Swiftfoot Boots"); SEI=("Seize the Day","Black Market Connections")
CFG={"baseline":base,"plus_Strionic_Resonator_minus_Swiftfoot_Boots":swap(base,[STR]),
     "plus_Seize_the_Day_minus_Black_Market_Connections":swap(base,[SEI]),
     "plus_Ultimo_minus_Crimson_Cowl":swap(base,[ULT]),"plus_Elektra_minus_Killmonger":swap(base,[ELE]),
     "candidate_Ultimo_and_Elektra":swap(base,[ULT,ELE]),
     "candidate_plus_Secluded_Courtyard_minus_Path_of_Ancestry":swap(base,[ULT,ELE,("Secluded Courtyard","Path of Ancestry")]),
     "candidate_plus_Strionic_Resonator_minus_Swiftfoot_Boots":swap(base,[ULT,ELE,STR])}
# ---- mana model
U,B,R='U','B','R'
LAND={"Island":(U,0),"Swamp":(B,0),"Mountain":(R,0),"Badlands":("BR",0),"Blood Crypt":("BR",0),"Steam Vents":("UR",0),"Watery Grave":("UB",0),
 "Underground Sea":("UB",0),"Volcanic Island":("UR",0),"Bloodstained Mire":("BR",0),"Polluted Delta":("UB",0),"Scalding Tarn":("UR",0),
 "Command Tower":("UBR",0),"Mana Confluence":("UBR",0),"Exotic Orchard":("UBR",0),"Luxury Suite":("BR",0),"Morphic Pool":("UB",0),"Training Center":("UR",0),
 "Dragonskull Summit":("BR","check"),"Drowned Catacomb":("UB","check"),"Sulfur Falls":("UR","check"),
 "Oscorp Industries":("UBR",1),"Path of Ancestry":("UBR",1),"Xander's Lounge":("UBR",1),
 "Otawara, Soaring City":(U,0),"Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth":("B",0),"Hall of Echoes":("C",0),
 "Cavern of Souls":("V",0),"Villainous Hideout":("V",0),"Secluded Courtyard":("V",0)}
ROCK={"Sol Ring":"CC","Arcane Signet":"UBR","Talisman of Creativity":"UR","Talisman of Dominance":"UB","Talisman of Indulgence":"BR","The Soul Stone":"B","Patchwork Banner":"UBR","Loki's Scepter":"UBR"}
def cost(n):
    mc=ALL[n].get('mana_cost') or ALL[n]['card_faces'][0]['mana_cost']
    pips=re.findall(r'\{(.)\}',mc.split(' // ')[0]); g=sum(int(p) for p in pips if p.isdigit()); col=[p for p in pips if p in 'UBR']
    return g,col
def isvill(n): return 'Villain' in ALL[n]['type_line'].split(' // ')[0] and 'Creature' in ALL[n]['type_line'].split(' // ')[0]
def pay(srcs,g,col,villain):
    """srcs: list of color-strings; 'V' = any colour for Villain creature spells else C; 'C' colourless. DFS assignment."""
    s=[("UBR" if (x=="V" and villain) else ("C" if x=="V" else x)) for x in srcs]
    if len(s)<g+len(col): return None
    col=sorted(col)
    def dfs(i,used):
        if i==len(col): return used
        for j,x in enumerate(s):
            if j not in used and col[i] in x:
                r=dfs(i+1,used|{j})
                if r is not None: return r
        return None
    used=dfs(0,frozenset())
    if used is None: return None
    rest=[j for j in range(len(s)) if j not in used]
    return set(used)|set(rest[:g])
def game(deck,rnd,T=7):
    d=deck[:]; rnd.shuffle(d); hand=d[:7]; lib=d[7:]
    lands=[]; rocks=[]; bf=set(); loki_turn=None; recs=[]
    for t in range(1,T+1):
        if t>1: hand.append(lib.pop(0))
        lh=[c for c in hand if c in LAND]; newtapped=False
        if lh:
            def untapped(c):
                k=LAND[c][1]
                if k=="check":
                    types={"Dragonskull Summit":"BR","Drowned Catacomb":"UB","Sulfur Falls":"UR"}[c]
                    return any((x in("Island","Swamp","Mountain","Badlands","Blood Crypt","Steam Vents","Watery Grave","Underground Sea","Volcanic Island","Bloodstained Mire","Polluted Delta","Scalding Tarn","Xander's Lounge") and set(LAND[x][0])&set(types)) or x=="Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth" for x in lands) or "Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth" in lands
                return k==0
            # play a tapped land early (t<=2) else prefer untapped
            pref=sorted(lh,key=lambda c:((0 if not untapped(c) else 1) if t<=2 else (0 if untapped(c) else 1), c in("Hall of Echoes",)))
            L=pref[0]; hand.remove(L); newtapped=not untapped(L); lands.append(L)
        srcs=[("UBR" if "Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth" in lands and LAND[x][0] not in("V","C") else LAND[x][0]) if not (i==len(lands)-1 and newtapped) else None for i,x in enumerate(lands)]
        srcs=[x for x in srcs if x]
        for r in rocks: srcs+= ["C","C"] if ROCK[r]=="CC" else [ROCK[r]]
        avail=srcs[:]
        def spend(n,villain):
            nonlocal avail
            g,col=cost(n)
            if villain: g=max(0,g-sum(x in bf for x in("Baron Strucker, HYDRA Overlord","Tombstone, Career Criminal")))
            u=pay(avail,g,col,villain)
            if u is None: return False
            avail=[x for j,x in enumerate(avail) if j not in u]; return True
        # Loki first if possible
        cast=[]
        if loki_turn is None and spend("Loki, the Deceiver",True): loki_turn=t; cast.append("Loki")
        # rocks cheapest first
        for r in sorted([c for c in hand if c in ROCK],key=lambda c:sum(cost(c)[0:1])+len(cost(c)[1])):
            if spend(r,False): hand.remove(r); rocks.append(r); avail+= ["C","C"] if ROCK[r]=="CC" else [ROCK[r]]
        if loki_turn is None and spend("Loki, the Deceiver",True): loki_turn=t; cast.append("Loki")
        # Villains cheapest first
        for v in sorted([c for c in hand if c in ALL and isvill(c)],key=lambda c:sum([cost(c)[0],len(cost(c)[1])])):
            if spend(v,True): hand.remove(v); bf.add(v); cast.append(v)
        eq=[c for c in hand if c in("Lightning Greaves","Swiftfoot Boots","Strionic Resonator")]
        for e in eq:
            if spend(e,False): hand.remove(e); bf.add(e)
        haste=("Lightning Greaves" in bf) or ("Swiftfoot Boots" in bf and len(avail)>=1)
        loki_can_attack= loki_turn is not None and (loki_turn<t or haste)
        target= any(isvill(x) for x in bf if x!="Loki, the Deceiver")
        attack= loki_can_attack and target
        strionic= attack and "Strionic Resonator" in bf and len(avail)-(1 if ("Swiftfoot Boots" in bf and loki_turn==t and "Lightning Greaves" not in bf) else 0)>=2
        seize= attack and "Seize the Day" in hand and pay(avail,3,[R],False) is not None
        recs.append(dict(loki=loki_turn is not None,attack=attack,strionic=strionic,seize=seize,
                         cheapV=any(isvill(x) and sum([cost(x)[0],len(cost(x)[1])])<=3 for x in bf),nV=len([x for x in bf if isvill(x)])))
    return recs
def run(deck,seed=28,N=20000,T=7):
    rnd=random.Random(seed); acc=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.Counter())
    for _ in range(N):
        for t,o in enumerate(game(deck,rnd,T),1):
            for k,v in o.items(): acc[t][k]+=v
    return {f"turn {t}":{"P_Loki_on_battlefield":round(a['loki']/N,4),"P_Loki_attacks_with_valid_other_Villain_target":round(a['attack']/N,4),
            "P_Strionic_activation_payable_on_attack":round(a['strionic']/N,4),"P_Seize_the_Day_castable_postcombat_on_attack":round(a['seize']/N,4),
            "P_cheap_Villain_MV3_or_less_deployed":round(a['cheapV']/N,4),"mean_nontoken_Villains_deployed":round(a['nV']/N,3)} for t,a in acc.items()}
A={k:run(d) for k,d in CFG.items()}
# ---- Part B exhaustive grid (rules-encoded, deterministic)
def scen(cfg,loki,vill,prot,removal,mana,master):
    """returns dict of outcomes for one turn. loki: absent|sick|ready; vill: none|valid|target_removed_in_response;
    prot: none|Greaves|Boots (Boots absent in Strionic cfg); removal: none|before_attacks|after_combat1; mana: spare mana after main1."""
    if prot=="Boots" and cfg=="strionic": return None
    if cfg!="strionic" and False: pass
    o=dict(copies=0,combats=0,loki_draws=0,bmc_draws=0,token_kept=0)
    o['bmc_draws']=1 if cfg in("baseline","strionic") else 0
    m=mana
    if loki=="absent": return o
    hasty = prot in("Greaves","Boots")
    if prot=="Boots": m-=1
    if m<0: return None
    if loki=="sick" and not hasty: return o
    shielded = prot in("Greaves","Boots")
    if removal=="before_attacks" and not shielded: return o
    combats=1
    o['combats']=1
    def one_combat(m):
        c=0
        if vill=="none": return c,m
        if vill=="target_removed_in_response": return c,m   # trigger fizzles (illegal target)
        c=1
        if cfg=="strionic" and m>=2: c+=1; m-=2
        return c,m
    c,m=one_combat(m); o['copies']+=c; o['loki_draws']+=1  # Loki (4/4) connects with evasion assumed
    if cfg=="seize" and m>=4 and not (removal=="after_combat1" and not shielded):
        m-=4; o['combats']=2; c2,m=one_combat(m); o['copies']+=c2; o['loki_draws']+=1
    o['token_kept']=o['copies'] if master else 0
    return o
GRID=dict(loki=["absent","sick","ready"],vill=["none","valid","target_removed_in_response"],prot=["none","Greaves","Boots"],
          removal=["none","before_attacks","after_combat1"],mana=[0,1,2,3,4,5,6],master=[False,True])
Bres={}
for cfg in("baseline","strionic","seize"):
    tot=collections.Counter(); n=0
    for combo in itertools.product(*GRID.values()):
        r=scen(cfg,*combo)
        if r is None: continue
        n+=1
        for k,v in r.items(): tot[k]+=v
    Bres[cfg]={"cells":n,**{f"mean_{k}":round(v/n,4) for k,v in tot.items()}}
# paired cells (same factors, Boots cells excluded so all three configs share them)
pair=collections.Counter(); np_=0
for combo in itertools.product(*GRID.values()):
    if combo[2]=="Boots": continue
    a,b,c=(scen(x,*combo) for x in("baseline","strionic","seize")); np_+=1
    pair['strionic_more_copies']+=b['copies']>a['copies']; pair['seize_more_copies']+=c['copies']>a['copies']
    pair['seize_more_draws_incl_BMC']+=(c['loki_draws']+c['bmc_draws'])>(a['loki_draws']+a['bmc_draws'])
    pair['seize_fewer_draws_incl_BMC']+=(c['loki_draws']+c['bmc_draws'])<(a['loki_draws']+a['bmc_draws'])
bo=collections.Counter()
for combo in itertools.product(*GRID.values()):
    if combo[2]!="Boots": continue
    wb=scen("baseline",*combo); nb=scen("baseline",combo[0],combo[1],"none",*combo[3:])
    if wb is None: continue
    bo['cells']+=1; bo['Boots_adds_a_combat_vs_no_equipment']+=wb['combats']>nb['combats']; bo['Boots_adds_copies_vs_no_equipment']+=wb['copies']>nb['copies']
out={"deck":"Loki__the_Deceiver","seed":28,"games_per_config":20000,"turns":7,"on":"the play, no mulligans",
 "partA_method":"Seeded finite Monte Carlo goldfish of deployment only. One land per turn (tapped lands preferred on turns 1-2, untapped afterwards; check-lands untapped if a qualifying typed land or Urborg is already in play; fetches resolved to an on-colour typed dual; Exotic Orchard treated as any colour; Cavern of Souls / Villainous Hideout / Secluded Courtyard give any colour only to Villain creature spells). Loki cast as soon as payable, then mana rocks cheapest first, then Villain creatures cheapest first with Baron Strucker / Tombstone discounts, then Lightning Greaves / Swiftfoot Boots / Strionic Resonator. Loki attacks on a turn if it was cast on an earlier turn or has Greaves / Boots (equip 1 paid), and another nontoken Villain is on the battlefield. No opponent, no blockers, no removal, no tutors, no Dark Ritual / Jeska's Will / Treasure / Urza's Incubator (conservative). Strionic payable = Strionic on the battlefield and 2 spare mana after deployment; Seize castable = Seize the Day in hand and {2}{R}+1 spare after deployment (cast in postcombat main).",
 "partA_results":A,
 "partB_method":"Exhaustive finite rules-encoded grid over Loki absent/summoning-sick/ready x other Villain none/valid/target removed in response x protection none/Lightning Greaves/Swiftfoot Boots x opposing targeted removal none/before attacks/after combat one x spare mana 0..6 x The Master, Multiplied absent/present. Rules encoded: Loki trigger needs another target Villain (fizzles if removed in response); Strionic copies the Loki attack trigger for {2} (one activation, it taps); Seize the Day must be cast postcombat for {3}{R} and Loki must survive combat one; Loki's draw counted once per combat in which Villains connect (Loki assumed to connect); the token is sacrificed at the next end step unless The Master is present; Black Market Connections counted as one draw (Buy Information) in the baseline and Strionic configs. Boots cells are excluded for the Strionic config (it removes Boots). These are manually encoded rules branches, not source-bound game-engine receipts and not win rates.",
 "partB_results":Bres,"partB_paired_cells_excluding_Boots":dict(cells=np_,**pair),"partB_Boots_marginal_cells_baseline_with_no_other_equipment":dict(bo)}
json.dump(out,open(W+'meas28.json','w'),indent=1)
for k,v in A.items():
    print(k.ljust(50),{t:(r['P_Loki_attacks_with_valid_other_Villain_target'],r['P_Strionic_activation_payable_on_attack'],r['P_Seize_the_Day_castable_postcombat_on_attack'],r['P_cheap_Villain_MV3_or_less_deployed'],r['mean_nontoken_Villains_deployed']) for t,r in v.items() if t in('turn 3','turn 4','turn 5','turn 6')})
print(json.dumps(Bres,indent=0)); print(out['partB_paired_cells_excluding_Boots'],dict(bo))
